sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1992
ACT III OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN
SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S
(SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1992.
An Act further to an tend the Balochistan Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (V of 1975)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th April, 1992]
No. PAB/Legis : III(27)/91,
dated 30-4-1992.--The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed by the
Provincial. Assembly of Balochistan on the 10th March, 1992 and assented to by
the Governor of Balochistan; is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial,
Assembly:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 17th day of November,
1990.

2. Amendment of section 6 of
Act V of 1975.---- In the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, for clauses (i) and (ii) of subsection
(4) of section 6, the following shall be substituted, namely:-
(i) in a house hired by Fixed
sum of Rupees twenty thou, and per
Government. month in lump sum
shall be paid to the
Speaker and
Deputy Speaker if they choose
to
reside in a hired house.
(ii) in his own house. Fifteen
thousand rupees per month shall be
paid to the
Speaker and Deputy Speaker.
